## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record the stable sequential position of a [`gmeow:TransparencyLogEntry`](../classes/gmeow-TransparencyLogEntry.md) within its append-only log — the log-local identity that survives mirror changes.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for a retrieval address (use [`gmeow:logEntryUrl`](gmeow-logEntryUrl.md)) or a ledger event's in-block position ([`gmeow:logIndex`](gmeow-logIndex.md)); and because it is functional, an entry has exactly one index within its log.

### How to use

- Set one integer index on the [`gmeow:TransparencyLogEntry`](../classes/gmeow-TransparencyLogEntry.md); combine it with the log's identity and a [`gmeow:logEntryUrl`](gmeow-logEntryUrl.md) so the entry can be re-fetched and re-verified.

### Examples

- ex:rekorEntry [`gmeow:logEntryIndex`](gmeow-logEntryIndex.md) 4815162342.
